title: open-weight frontier LLM architectural ideas — full family survey (June 2026)
name: frontier-models
summary: Status snapshot of the DISTINCTIVE architectural ideas across ALL major open-weight LLM families as of 2026-06-22 — extending the prior frontier-gap.json crowded-axes (5 Chinese labs) to the full field: + Google Gemma, Meta Llama, Mistral, OpenAI gpt-oss, AI2 OLMo, Microsoft Phi, Cohere Command. Two sections: (1) crowded-axes = convergent ideas ≥2 labs share (extends the original 8 to 14), (2) per-family-ideas = each lab's distinctive bets. Vendor-claimed-unverified items flagged vendor_claimed:true. Grafts as children under the frontier-gap node.
note: Scratch research artifact (docs scratchDir = state/scratch/). Sibling to frontier-gap.json / glm-5.2.json. NOT a hexa-codex architecture node until grafted (governance c4). Latest-flagship performance numbers (V4 KV%, GLM IndexShare 2.9x, Kimi agentic depth, M3 MSA, Mistral/Cohere 2026 specs) are vendor-claimed and just-released; foundational mechanisms (KDA/GSPO/CISPO/MLA/aux-loss-free/MatFormer/MXFP4) are paper-confirmed. CORRECTION vs prior baseline: KDA lives in the separate Kimi Linear research model, NOT the K2 flagship line (K2/K2.5/K2.6 use MLA full attention).

meta.gemma4_finding: Gemma 4 EXISTS — released 2026-03/04 (E2B/E4B/31B dense/26B-A4B MoE); latest is Gemma 4 12B Unified (2026-06-03, encoder-free unified image+audio+text). Gemma 3/3n are the PRIOR generation. The user's '젬마4' is real, not fabricated.
meta.llama_finding: Meta's latest OPEN-WEIGHT model is still Llama 4 Scout+Maverick (2025-04-05). Behemoth (~2T) never shipped (shelved). No Llama 5. Meta reportedly pivoted to a closed API reasoning model in 2026 — open-weight frontier stalled at Llama 4. (Behemoth/Llama-5 status via tech press, not a Meta technical report.)

children.name: crowded-axes
children.summary: Convergent architectural ideas ≥2 open-weight labs share (the capital/GPU battleground — NOT where hexa-codex competes). Original 8 from the 5 Chinese labs, SHARPENED with June-2026 flagships, + 6 NEW axes surfaced by the full-field survey (Gemma/Llama/Mistral/gpt-oss/OLMo/Phi/Cohere). 14 total.

children.name: trainable-sparse-attention
children.summary: Lightning-indexer + top-k token/block pre-selection feeding MLA. DeepSeek DSA (top-k=2048, V3.2) → V4 alternating CSA (compress-KV-4x→sparse-block-pick) + HCA (compress-128x→dense); GLM-5.2 MLA+DSA; MiniMax M3 MSA. The de-facto 1M-context primitive; most crowded axis.

children.name: hybrid-linear-full-attention
children.summary: Linear-RNN:full interleave to cut KV cache: Qwen3.5 GatedDeltaNet 3:1, Kimi Linear KDA 3:1 (per-channel-gate refinement), OLMo Hybrid 3:1, Jamba (Mamba). CONTESTED — MiniMax M2 reverted to full softmax (multi-hop reasoning silently degraded); Kimi flagship K2.x stays MLA-full.

children.name: ultra-sparse-moe
children.summary: Active/total ratio collapsing toward ~3-5%: Qwen3.5 17B/397B (256 experts, 8+1), Mistral Small 4 6B/119B (128 experts top-4), gpt-oss 5.1B/117B, OLMoE 1.3B/6.9B (64 top-8), DeepSeek V4 49B/1.6T. Shared experts + DeepSeek aux-loss-free routing-bias (±γ per-step nudge) now universal.

children.name: grpo-variant-rl
children.summary: Named fixes to GRPO/PPO token-level-clip flaw, divergent per lab: Qwen GSPO (sequence-level IS, kills MoE Routing-Replay), MiniMax CISPO (clip IS-weight not token), Mistral Magistral GRPO+Clip-Higher (no-KL), DeepSeek unified-GRPO, OLMo Tülu-RLVR.

children.name: verifiable-reward-agent-envs
children.summary: Execution-environment fleets with reward = real test-pass/tool-execution (no LLM judge): Qwen 20k parallel envs, MiniMax 200k+, Kimi 23k-tool synth, DeepSeek agentic-synthesis, OLMo RLVR. Long-horizon tool chains (Kimi K2.6 vendor-claims 300 sub-agents / 4000 steps / 12h runs — unverified).

children.name: graded-test-time-compute
children.summary: Thinking-effort dial universal: DeepSeek Non/High/Max, GLM-5.2 High/Max, Qwen budget, Kimi 96k/128k, gpt-oss low/med/high (system-prompt keyword), Mistral Medium 3.5 configurable. Reasoning is a knob, not a mode.

children.name: mtp-speculative-decoding
children.summary: Multi-token prediction baked into pretraining (draft head shares trunk) for self-speculative decode: DeepSeek, Qwen3-Next, GLM (5 draft tokens), Kimi; Cohere Command A+ MoE-optimized spec-decode (1.5-1.6x). Now table-stakes for serving throughput.

children.name: sub8bit-quant-domestic-silicon
children.summary: Sub-8bit weights now standard: DeepSeek V4 FP4-MoE+QAT (rest FP8), Kimi native INT4 weight-only QAT in post-training (~2x speed, ~50% mem), gpt-oss MXFP4 (E2M1, 4.25-bit, MoE-only, single-80GB-GPU). DeepSeek V4-Pro vendor-claims ~1000 Huawei Ascend 910C post-training (CUDA-independence; unverified).

children.name: learned-attention-sink
children.summary: NEW. Each head learns a trainable scalar added to the softmax denominator so it can 'opt out' of all tokens — a learned generalization of StreamingLLM's fixed sink token. gpt-oss (alternating 128-tok banded/dense layers + per-head sink bias). Generalizes Mistral SWA / Gemma local-global interleave.

children.name: cross-layer-index-reuse
children.summary: NEW. Adjacent DSA layers share 70-100% of selected sparse indices → run the indexer once per N layers and reuse: GLM-5.2 IndexShare (1 index/4 layers, ~2.9x FLOP cut @1M, vendor-claimed). Generalized as IndexCache (arXiv 2603.12201 — vLLM/SGLang patch for any DSA model, 1.82x prefill; has code, strongest-evidenced).

children.name: local-global-attention-interleave
children.summary: NEW. Cheap local sliding-window layers alternated with sparse global layers to bound long-ctx KV: Gemma 2 1:1 → Gemma 3 5:1 (1024-tok window), Mistral 7B SWA (W=4096, rolling KV cache), gpt-oss banded. Window-based (vs indexer-based sparse-attn); distinct from Llama 4 iRoPE NoPE/RoPE interleave.

children.name: teacher-distillation-synthetic-data
children.summary: NEW. Data-quality-over-architecture: train small models on larger-teacher soft logits / curated synthetic CoT. Gemma distills from Gemini teachers; Phi-4-reasoning distills o3-mini traces + multi-agent self-revising synthetic data (GPT-4-class at ~200B tok vs ~1T); Qwen distills. The SLM thesis Phi pioneered.

children.name: early-fusion-unified-multimodal
children.summary: NEW. Native early-fusion of text+vision(+audio) tokens into ONE backbone (vs late vision adapter): Llama 4 early-fusion, Gemma 4 12B Unified encoder-free image+audio+text, Mistral Pixtral, Cohere Command A+ vision. Converging direction; Gemma 4 encoder-free unified + Llama 4 early-fusion lead.

children.name: matformer-elastic-edge-inference
children.summary: NEW. On-device elastic-inference stack: Gemma 3n MatFormer (Matryoshka transformer — smaller fully-functional submodels nested in a big one) + Per-Layer-Embeddings offloaded to CPU RAM (E2B/E4B in ~2-3GB accel mem). Largely Gemma-unique; Ministral/Phi-mini target edge but without MatFormer nesting.

children.name: per-family-ideas
children.summary: Each open-weight family's DISTINCTIVE architectural bets (current flagship as of 2026-06-22). Convergent ideas live in crowded-axes above; this section keeps only what differentiates each lab.

children.name: deepseek
children.summary: DeepSeek-V4 (Apr 2026, MIT; V4-Pro 49B/1.6T, 1M ctx). DISTINCTIVE: alternating CSA(sparse-block)+HCA(dense-compressed) attention replacing single DSA; FP4-MoE QAT training; Muon optimizer + mHC (Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections) residual; pioneered MLA latent-KV + aux-loss-free routing (now field-wide).

children.name: qwen
children.summary: Qwen open flagship Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (Feb 2026) → Qwen3.6 agentic-coding; Qwen-Max stays closed. DISTINCTIVE: productionized GatedDeltaNet 3:1 linear:full hybrid at scale (256 experts, 8+1 shared, 262K ctx); GSPO RL (sequence-level IS+clip) that eliminates the MoE Routing-Replay trick (arXiv 2507.18071).

children.name: glm-zhipu
children.summary: GLM-5.2 (Jun 2026, MIT; ~744B/40B, 1M ctx, ARC agentic-reasoning-coding). DISTINCTIVE: IndexShare runs the DSA indexer 1x/4 layers reusing top-k indices (~2.9x FLOP cut @1M, vendor-claimed); inherits DeepSeek MLA+DSA; co-published IndexCache (arXiv 2603.12201, 70-100% cross-layer index overlap).

children.name: kimi-moonshot
children.summary: Kimi K2.6 (Apr 2026; K2/K2.5/K2.6 all MLA FULL attention). DISTINCTIVE: MuonClip = Muon+QK-Clip (bounds attention logits → 15.5T-tok pretrain, zero loss spikes, arXiv 2507.20534); native INT4 weight-only QAT on 1T-MoE. NOTE: KDA (per-channel-gated linear attn) is in the SEPARATE Kimi Linear model, NOT the K2 flagship.

children.name: minimax
children.summary: MiniMax-M3 (Jun 2026, open, 1M ctx): M1 lightning/linear → M2 full-softmax REVERSION → M3 re-adds block-sparse MSA. DISTINCTIVE: documented M2 revert (hybrid had multi-hop-reasoning deficits worsening with context) — a public counter-narrative to linear hybrids; CISPO RL (clip IS-weight not token, arXiv 2506.13585).

children.name: gemma-google
children.summary: Gemma 4 EXISTS (latest = Gemma 4 12B Unified, Jun 3 2026, Apache-2.0, 256K ctx; E2B/E4B/31B-dense/26B-A4B-MoE). DISTINCTIVE: 5:1 local-window:global attn (G3); Gemini-teacher distillation; G2 logit soft-capping (dropped for QK-norm); G3n MatFormer+Per-Layer-Embeddings edge; G4 encoder-free unified image+audio+text.

children.name: llama-meta
children.summary: Llama 4 Scout+Maverick (Apr 2025) — Meta's latest OPEN weights; Behemoth shelved, no Llama 5. DISTINCTIVE: first Llama MoE (Scout 17B/109B; Maverick 17B/400B 128-expert); iRoPE interleaved NoPE/RoPE + attn-temp scaling claiming 10M-ctx on Scout (vendor-claimed, unreproduced); native early-fusion multimodal + GQA.

children.name: mistral
children.summary: Latest open: Mistral Medium 3.5 (Apr 2026, ~128B dense) + Small 4 (6B/119B MoE). DISTINCTIVE: first competitive fully-open SMoE (Mixtral top-2-of-8 → top-4-of-128 ~5% active); sliding-window+rolling-KV legacy (now deprecated for full-attn 256K); Magistral pure-RL reasoning (GRPO Clip-Higher, NO distillation, arXiv 2506.10910).

children.name: openai-gpt-oss
children.summary: gpt-oss-120b/20b (Aug 2025, Apache-2.0, genuinely open weights; 117B/5.1B & 21B/3.6B, top-4 MoE). DISTINCTIVE: MXFP4 quant on MoE FFN weights only (4.25-bit, attn/embed BF16 → 120b fits one 80GB GPU); learned per-head attention-sink bias on alternating banded/dense layers; Harmony 3-channel format (analysis/commentary/final).

children.name: ai2-olmo
children.summary: OLMo 3 (Nov 2025) + OLMo Hybrid (GatedDeltaNet 3:1) + OLMoE (1.3B/6.9B). DISTINCTIVE: radical FULL openness — weights+full data (Dolma)+code+1000s of checkpoints (unique at scale; OLMo 3-Think = first fully-open reasoning model); post-sublayer RMSNorm+QK-Norm+Z-loss stability (arXiv 2501.00656); Dolmino anneal + model souping.

children.name: microsoft-phi
children.summary: Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B (Mar 2026; Phi-5 unannounced). DISTINCTIVE: 'data quality > architecture' — multi-agent self-revising synthetic data + CoT distillation (distills o3-mini traces on curated 'teachable' prompts), GPT-4-class reasoning at ~200B tok vs ~1T. Dense+GQA no MoE; pioneered the textbook-synthetic-data SLM line.

children.name: cohere-command
children.summary: Command A+ (May 2026, Apache-2.0; 218B/25B-active MoE, top-8-of-128 + shared always-on expert, 128K). DISTINCTIVE: enterprise/sovereign — native citation-grounded RAG, 48 langs (all EU-official), MoE-optimized spec-decode (1.5-1.6x), runs on 2xH100/1xB200. Shared-expert MoE echoes DeepSeek-MoE.
